title: Tautulli
descript: Tautulli is a monitoring and statistics companion for Plex Media Server: play history, live streams, bandwidth and library statistics, and notifications. This package runs the official LinuxServer.io image as a non-root container with all Linux capabilities dropped, and keeps its data in the app data folder. Tautulli needs an existing Plex server - sign in, complete the setup wizard with the Plex URL and token, and the dashboard starts collecting usage. Without Plex the web UI, settings and logs still work.
important: Requires DockerEngine and Plex. First login: user tautulli, password generated at first start and stored in DockerAppData/tautullidocker/config/initial-password.txt (mode 600) - change it in Settings, then delete that file. Data stays on your NAS, no telemetry. A normal uninstall keeps the folder, uninstall with data removal deletes it. Plain HTTP on the LAN - use a TLS reverse proxy before exposing it. Privacy policy: see the Help link.
release_note: 2.19.1-3: review remediation for S6, S11, S9, V1 and F5. No credential is shipped any more: the wrapper generates a random admin password at first start, keeps only its PBKDF2 hash in config.ini and writes the plaintext to config/initial-password.txt (600), which is deleted automatically once you change the password. The container drops all capabilities and sets no-new-privileges on top of uid 1000, data is 700/600. The description now matches what runs without Plex. Login-to-dashboard verified by test/smoke.sh.

zh-hk.descript: Tautulli 是 Plex Media Server 的監控與統計面板：記錄播放歷史、即時工作階段、頻寬和媒體庫統計，並可傳送通知。本應用執行 LinuxServer.io 官方鏡像，以非 root 使用者執行並丟棄全部 Linux 能力，資料儲存在應用程式資料目錄。Tautulli 需要既有的 Plex 伺服器：登入後在精靈中填入 Plex 位址與 Token，儀表板即開始收集資料。未連線 Plex 時網頁介面、設定與日誌仍可正常使用。
zh-hk.important: 需要 DockerEngine 和 Plex。初始登入：使用者名稱 tautulli，密碼在首次啟動時隨機產生並寫入 DockerAppData/tautullidocker/config/initial-password.txt（權限 600），登入後請在設定中修改密碼並刪除該檔案。資料儲存在 NAS，不上傳遙測。一般解除安裝保留資料目錄，選擇刪除資料才會清除。頁面是區域網路明文 HTTP，暴露公網前請加 TLS 反向代理。隱私政策見說明連結。
zh-hk.release_note: 2.19.1-3：針對審核 S6、S11、S9、V1、F5 的整改。包內不再內建任何憑證：首啟密碼由包裝指令碼隨機產生，config.ini 僅保存 PBKDF2 雜湊，明文寫入 config/initial-password.txt（權限 600），修改密碼後自動刪除。容器在 uid 1000 基礎上丟棄全部 Linux 能力並啟用 no-new-privileges，資料目錄 700、關鍵檔案 600。描述已與實際可用功能對齊（未連線 Plex 時網頁介面、設定與日誌可用）。已用 test/smoke.sh 實測登入到儀表板。

data_notes: All persistent data stays on the NAS in `config` (`config.ini`, `tautulli.db`, cache, and the first-start `initial-password.txt`, which is removed once you change the password). No telemetry is sent. Copying the folder is a complete backup; uninstall with data removal deletes it.
design_notes: **Non-root container, empty capability set.** The service runs as uid 1000 (measured on hardware: `id -u` = 1000) and additionally drops every Linux capability (`cap_drop: [ALL]`) and sets `no-new-privileges`. Measured inside the running container: `CapEff 0000000000000000`, `CapBnd 0000000000000000`, `NoNewPrivs 1`. No privileged mode, host network, Docker socket or `cap_add`. `docs/ROOT-PRIVILEGE.md` records the analysis for S11/V1 - the upstream image declares no USER, the package pins the runtime user, and no root exemption is requested.

**No shipped credential (S6).** Tautulli 2.19 prints a random setup-wizard password to the container log, which is unusable from the App Center. `src/entrypoint.sh` therefore generates its own random password on the first start, keeps only the PBKDF2 hash in `/config/config.ini` and writes the plaintext to `/config/initial-password.txt` (mode 600) in the app data folder. Nothing secret is printed to the log, and the file is deleted automatically once the user changes the password.

**Private data directory (S11).** The wrapper runs with `umask 077`, sets `/config` to 700 and the credential/history files to 600; the app inherits the umask, so `config.ini`, `tautulli.db` and the logs are created 600.
**One volume.** The database, settings and cache are all below `/config`; no other host path is written.

**Privacy.** The package sends no telemetry; the only outbound connection is the Plex server you configure (plus Tautulli's optional upstream update check). `PRIVACY.md` documents this and is linked from the package Help field.
**Health check** probes the web UI on container port 8181 (it answers with a redirect to the login page).
**Fixed image tag, never `:latest`**, Docker Hub only, no `privileged`, no `network_mode: host`, no Docker socket, no `cap_add`.
limitations: Tautulli is a companion for an existing Plex Media Server; without Plex the web UI, settings, logs and notification configuration work, but there are no statistics.
The first password is generated at install time and stored as plain text (mode 600) in `config/initial-password.txt`; change it at the first login and the file is deleted on the next restart.
The page is plain HTTP on the LAN; use a TLS reverse proxy before exposing it to the internet.
Uninstalling without data removal keeps `/Volume1/DockerAppData/tautullidocker` so a reinstall can reuse the history and settings; choose data removal in the App Center to delete it.
Docker applications cannot be upgraded in place in the App Center: updating means uninstalling and reinstalling, which keeps the data folder.

wrapper_note_readme: - **First login without a shipped credential**: Tautulli prints a random setup-wizard password only in the container log, which the App Center does not show. `src/entrypoint.sh` therefore generates its own random password on the first start, stores only the PBKDF2 hash in `/config/config.ini` and writes the plaintext to `config/initial-password.txt` (mode 600) in the app data folder. Change it at the first login; the file is deleted on the next restart once the stored hash no longer matches.
